title: motion-strip prime render discards capture_frame's image without UnloadImage
evidence:
harness/motion_strip.odin:143-148 (the internal prime render — the returned rl.Image is dropped):
			if (win_start - start_ms) % step_ms != 0 || win_start < start_ms {
				alpha: f32 = 1.0
				if !snapshot && !paused {
					alpha = 0.0
				}
				capture_frame(rc, &state.topology, &state.bundles, &state.flow, &state.crisis, &state.health,
					state.health_enabled, sim_tick, state.era, state.seed, nil, alpha)

harness/motion_strip.odin:193-197 (the exported path, by contrast, unloads):
	img := capture_frame(rc, &state.topology, &state.bundles, &state.flow, &state.crisis, &state.health,
		state.health_enabled, sim_tick, state.era, state.seed, nil, alpha)
	path := fmt.tprintf("%s/%s-%06dms.png", outdir, demo_name, ms)
	rl.ExportImage(img, strings.clone_to_cstring(path, context.temp_allocator))
	rl.UnloadImage(img)
detail: capture_frame returns LoadImageFromScreen (a heap-allocated 1280×720 buffer). Every prime tick leaks ~3.5MB; a strip window primes ~17+ times. Every other capture_frame call site (harness/goldens.odin) unloads.
recommended_fix: Bind and free the prime image: `img := capture_frame(...); rl.UnloadImage(img)` — mirroring render_strip_frame.

title: a11y_reduced golden cannot exercise the new trail echo-off gate — trail_n is always 0 in golden captures
detail: The claim that the a11y_reduced golden exercises echo-off is false as stated: its T2 captures render snapshot-exact, so the `!v.reduced_motion` branch never evaluates. The reduced pin is verified only for pulse_read; the trail gate is app/motion-strip-only.
recommended_fix: Verify echo suppression via `harness motion-strip a11y_reduced <win>` (interp mode applies a11y pins) asserting zero echo pixels, or a unit test of the predicate.

title: run_motion_strip re-implements run_demo's wall-tick walk + action-log command batching
detail: The blessed sim-timeline walk now exists in two copies. If run_demo's loop later changes (new command source, pause semantics), the strip silently diverges from the T1-pinned timeline and its evidence misleads.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared step-once helper (paused_at + action_log batch + pp.step + event clear) used by run_demo, replay, and run_motion_strip.
